normalization.p: The text is normalized in accordance with the International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration (IAST). Daṇḍas are rendered as / and //; the avagraha is rendered by the apostrophe; ṁ has been normalized to ṃ. Non-conformant characters that carry additional information (here: ï, marking hiatus in Prakrit) are kept in orig elements inside choice, with the IAST-conformant equivalent in reg, so that a plain text can be derived.

segmentation.p: The text is structured by div elements (the act, its prologue), by speeches (sp), verses (lg, one l per line of the input) and prose (p). Stage directions are marked as stage. Editorial supplements in square brackets inside a word are marked supplied.

lg.l: sa śrīmān kṛpayā mahāgaṇapatiḥ puṣṇātu niḥśreyasam //

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ

lg.l: senānyā bhagavan bhavāny api bhavān evety anūdbodhitas
tallābhād iva nirvṛto diśatu vaḥ śreyo 'rdhanārīśvaraḥ //

sp.p: iti puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīrya, nepathyābhimukham avalokya, ārye, itas tāvat /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: ārye, adya khalu bhagavato madhyārjunaprabhor yātrāpratyupasthitaiḥ śamadamapradhānair brahmaniṣṭhair ādiṣṭo 'smi sāmājikair adhyātmakathānubandhabandhuraṃ kim apy apūrvaṃ nāṭakaṃ nāṭayitavyam iti / tad anucintyatāṃ tvayā tathāvidhaṃ nāṭakam /

p.seg: ajja, kiṃ vi me ṇa paḍihāi /
ārya, kim api me na pratibhāti /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: ayi vismaraṇaśīle, tvam ajaivāsi prakṛtyā /

p.seg: jai evvaṃ tado ajjassa aṇurūvā bhavissaṃ /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: sakrodhāvegam mugdhe, prakṛtyāham api yady ajaḥ syām tarhi tadanurūpa ācāraḥ pakṣe tvatparityāgarūpa eva paryavasyed iti mahad aniṣṭam āpadyeta / tathā khalv ajānām ācāro dṛśyate /

lg.l: eko hy ajas tām anuśeta eva

p.seg: bhuttabhoaṃ maṃ ujjhia aṇṇāe ka e vi kaṇṇāe saṃgadua ṇivvudo hodu ajjo /
bhuktabhogāṃ mām ujjhitvā 'nyayā kayāpi kanyayā saṃgatya nirvṛto bhavatv āryaḥ /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: sānunayaṃ haste gṛhītvā ayi sadasadvilakṣaṇe, vācārambhaṇamātra eva prapañco na paramārthaḥ / tad ehi, mā nivartasva / nartitavyaṃ nāma tvayā yāvat pratibhāsaṃ prārabdhānusāreṇa / tatas tu paraṃ svata eva parāvartiṣyase /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: jīvanmuktikalyāṇaṃ nāma nāṭakam, yasya kaviḥ subhadrāpariṇayaśṛṅgārasarvasvacittavṛttikalyāṇādvaitarasamañjaryādyanekaprabandhanibandhanābhinandanīyaḥ śrībālacandramakhindranandano nallādhvarī /

p.seg: ajja, sumarāvidamhi / visumaraṇakido uṇa maha avarāho marisidavvo /
ārya, smāritā 'smi / vismaraṇakṛtaḥ punar mamāparādho marṣitavyaḥ /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: astu nāmedam / prastūyatāṃ saṃgītakam / saṃprati hi,

lg.l: ṇa khu sā rājīvatadī khamadi bhamaralakkhaṇappaparihūdiṃ //
na khalu sā rājīvatatiḥ kṣamate bhramaralakṣaṇātmaparibhūtim //
kavir atimanojñasūktiḥ kathā jagatpāvanī vayaṃ kṛtinaḥ /
pariṣad iyaṃ guṇaniṣṭhā bhavyasya vidheḥ prasādavibhavo 'yam //

sp.p: aye bharatakulaśekhara, vidhiprasādavibhava iti māṃ nirdiśañ ślāghanīyo 'si /

lg.l: codanātmā vidhis tasya prasādo janako mama /

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: smṛtim abhinīya katham eṣa praviṣṭa eva bhāvo jīvāmātyasya ramaṇīyacaraṇasya bhūmikām ādāya raṅgamaṇḍapam / ārye, tadā āvām apy anantarakaraṇīyāya sajjībhavāvaḥ / iti niṣkrāntau

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: api ca,
kiṃ ca,

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: vatse, kim anyat? devasya tvayā sāhāyakam ācaritavyam /

lg.l: yaś ca vyādhakule vasann iva mahīpālātmajo vyādhatāṃ
jīvatvaṃ gatavān vimohavaśataḥ svasmāt padād bhraṃśitaḥ //

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: pāṇigrahaṇamahotsavaḥ /

p.seg: ajja, atthi khu tassa puḍhamo paḍiggaho devī, yā buddhi tti andakaraṇam tti maṇaṃ tti cittaṃ tti a bhaṇïiadi /
ārya, asti khalu tasya prathamaḥ pratigraho devī, yā buddhir ity antaḥkaraṇam iti mana iti cittam iti ca bhaṇyate /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: saṃprati tasyāṃ vairasyenopajātajihāso devaḥ /

p.seg: haddhi haddhi, chāādavāṇaṃ vïia samaṇïiadāṇaṃ vi tāṇaṃ īriso dasāpariṇāmo
hā dhik, hā dhik / chāyātapayor iva samaniyatayor api tayor īdṛśo daśāpariṇāmaḥ /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: vatse, chāyātapayor iveti viṣamo dṛṣṭāntaḥ /

lg.l: chāyaiṣā punar ātapo 'yam iti ca spaṣṭaṃ pratītātmanor
anyonyaṃ vyatiṣaktayor api tayor bhedaḥ sukhaṃ gṛhyate /
buddhir jīva iti dvayor api tayor bhedagraho durlabhaḥ //

p.seg: ajja, īrisī a devī kīsa deveṇa virasadāe goarīkidā?
ārya, īdṛśī devī kasmād devena virasatāyā gocarīkṛtā?

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: yatas tatsamgamaprabhṛti sukham iti kiṃcin na jānāti devaḥ / tathā hi,

lg.l: puṇyāpuṇyamayeṣu karmasu tato mohāt pravṛttaḥ svayam /

sp.p: uktaṃ ca māṃ prati garbhagṛhaṃ praviṣṭena devena,

lg.l: yātāyātakṛtā yayā mama cirād ātmettham āyāsyate /
asmād garbhagṛhād bahir yadi vinirgamyeta kiṃcin mayā

sp.p: iti

p.seg: haddhi, haddhi / sāhasavvavasāo devo / ajja, kahaṃ so gabbhadharaaṃ paviṭṭo? iṭhṭhādikāridāe dhūmādimaggeṇa candaloaṃ gado tti khu suṇijjaïi /
hā dhik, hā dhik / sāhasavyavasāyo devaḥ / ārya, kathaṃ sa garbhagṛhaṃ praviṣṭaḥ? iṣṭādikāritayā dhūmādimārgeṇa candralokaṃ gata iti khalu śrūyate /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: vatse, śrūyatām,

lg.l: śraddhādyāhutipañcakena ca pathā yoniṃ gato brāhmaṇīṃ
garbhāgāram anupraviśya daśame māse tato nirgataḥ //

sp.p: saṃprati ca,

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: vatse, anyad apy asti kāraṇaṃ devījihāsāyāṃ devasya, yat purāṇajyotirvidām anukramaṇam / yathā,
iti

p.seg: ajja, kā uṇa kaṇṇā tārisī jāe joeṇa devassa sapadappattī vavadisijjaïi /
ārya, kā punaḥ kanyā tādṛśī, yasyā yogena devasya svapadaprāptir vyapadiśyate /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: adyāpi nāvadhāryate / preṣitas tāvan mayā tādṛśakanyānveṣaṇāyāpātabodho nāmādhuniko devānucaraḥ /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: kiṃ tādṛśī kanyaiva durupalambheti tathā bravīṣi, āho svid upalabdhāpi devasya durlabheti?

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: ayi vatse,

lg.l: devo 'yaṃ svapadāc cyutaḥ kila kuto bhūyo 'pi tasyodayaḥ
śreyo vā tad idaṃ pumarthapariṣanmūrdhābhiṣiktaṃ kutaḥ /
ity evaṃ yadi manyase hṛdi tadā mithyaiva te niścayas
tat tasya kva gataṃ padaṃ kva nu gato devaḥ sa vā saṃprati //

sp.p: paraṃ tu mocanīyo devaḥ pāśabandhād ajñānavarmaṇa aindrajālikasya / ya eṣaḥ,

p.seg: ajja, kiṃ so jo devīe tādo tti suṇijjaïi / haddhi haddhi / dujjao khu so /
ārya, kiṃ sa yo devyās tāta iti śrūyate / hā dhik, hā dhik / durjayaḥ khalu saḥ /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: saroṣam vatse, kim ucyate durjaya iti /

lg.l: paśyainaṃ paśukalpam alpadhiṣaṇaṃ baddhvā padākramya ca /
chindan krandata eva tattvam asinā tasyāṅgakaṃ khaṇḍaśo
viśvagrāsaparasya tena mahato bhūtasya kuryāṃ balim //

p.seg: ajja, mā kuppa / arihi kāmādihiṃ karijjantasāhāao so saṅkidavvo tti taha mantemi /
ārya, mā kupya / aribhiḥ kāmādibhiḥ kriyamāṇasāhāyakaḥ sa śaṅkitavya iti tathā mantrayāmi /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: nirūpya katham ita eva devaḥ /

lg.l: vikṛṣyamāṇaḥ parito 'pi devyā guruvyathaḥ saṃmukham abhyupaiti //

div.stage: tataḥ praviśati yathānirdiṣṭo jīvaḥ, buddhiś ca rathena vibhavataś ca parivāraḥ /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ

lg.l: sa eṣa madhuraḥ svaro rucira eṣa rūpoccayaḥ
susaurabham idaṃ tv iyaṃ śiśiratā raso 'sāv iti /
itaḥ śravaṇam ekato nayanam anyato ghrāṇam
apy atas tvag api hanta māṃ rasanam agrataḥ karṣati //

sp.p: devi, stimitagatayaḥ kriyantāṃ vājinaḥ / yataḥ,

lg.l: dhāvanto viṣayeṣu sāṃpratam amī rathyās tava preraṇād
vyākarṣanti yathāyathaṃ tata itas tvām antato mām api /
āstāṃ tāvad idaṃ rathasya tu mahān āyāsayogaḥ paraṃ
na hy eṣa kṣamate śirīṣasumato 'py atyantam āpeśalaḥ //

sp.p: katham eṣā madvacanam ākarṇya vighūrṇate bhūtāviṣṭeva / bhavatu, etān evāśvān pratisāntvayāmi /

lg.l: alam alam itaḥ śrāntaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhena viramyatām
aham uparato mā mā karṣantu mām ayam añjaliḥ //

sp.p: atha vā na durmadeṣv eteṣu sāntvavādaḥ kramate / hanta hanta,
ākāśe ramaṇīyacaraṇa, kvāsi bhoḥ kvāsi /

lg.l: na kiṃ paryāpnoti bhramaṇam idam etāvad api me /
kiyantaṃ vā kālaṃ bhramayitum ito 'pi vyavasitaṃ
yathāsaṃkalpaṃ te bhavatu mama vā kiṃ pratihatam //

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: apasṛtya vijayatāṃ devaḥ /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: aye ramaṇīyacaraṇa,

lg.l: ahaṃ bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ krakacaparuṣe vai śrutipathe
pariśrānto nātaḥ padam api samartho vicalitum /
prabhutvaṃ mayy ārte prakaṭayasi kiṃ sāṃpratam idaṃ

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: dāsajane 'smin na sāṃpratam atimātraṃ vacanaṃ kalyāṇaśevadher devasya /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: sanirvedam aticāriṇyā buddhyā saha saṃsarato mama kalyāṇe kā nyūnatā nāma / yathā,

lg.l: bhūyaḥ preraṇakarmaṇā svayam api protsāhayantī muhuḥ /
svasthaṃ māṃ viṣameṣv amīṣu viṣayeṣv ākṛṣya cākṛṣya ca
bhrāmyantī kṛpayā hriyā ca rahitā nādyāpi viśrāmyati //

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: deva, samakṣam eva devyāḥ katham evam ākrośaḥ kriyate /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: eṣā saṃpraty ātmānam api na jānāti / paśya, paśya,

lg.l: tadvad buddhir apīyam indriyacayadvārā bahir nirgatā

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: tarhi na khedāvasaro devasya /

lg.l: āruhya gacchatu bhavān api tāṃ pramātā

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: ko nāma vinodaḥ saṃsāraviṣavallarībījanyāsena pramātṛbhāvena / tathā hi,

lg.l: pramātṛtvāveśe sati bhavati karmasv adhikṛtis tataḥ
kartṛtvaṃ syāt tadanu phalabhoktṛtvam api ca /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: kiṃcid iva parāvṛtya vatse sattvaśuddhe, ehi vandasva devam /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: vatse, abhimatena yujyasva /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: aho, sattvaśuddhyāḥ saṃsparśamātreṇa prasannā devī prakṛtisthā ca saṃvṛttā /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: devi, mā maivam / yatas tvayi pariṣvaktāyām aham api pariṣvaktaprāya eva /

lg.l: dhyāyatīva janas tv eṣa dhyāyantyām tvayi vallabhe /
calatīva calantyāṃ ca na svatantraḥ svayaṃ kvacit //

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: kim etad upacāraḥ /

lg.l: nīrakṣīravad āvayor upanatā kālād bahor ekatā
viśleṣasya kathā kathaṃcid api na svapne 'pi saṃbhāvyate /
kiṃ ca tvadguṇasāratāmahimataḥ karteti bhokteti ca

p.seg: edaṃ vi ṇāma ajjauttassa paḍiggahappahā go / kahaṃ aṇṇahā muddhapakidīe maha taha taha ppahāsaṃbhavo /
etad api nāmāryaputrasya parigrahaprabhāvaḥ / katham anyathā mugdhaprakṛter api mama tathā tathā prathāsaṃbhavaḥ /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ

lg.l: mūḍhaḥ piteti tanayo 'pi kathaṃ tathā syāl

sp.p: api ca,

lg.l: mugdhe devi parigrahas tvam iti yat tenānubhāvena me
jīvo jīva iti praśastir iyatī viśvaṃ yayā vyāpyate /
no ced evam apāṇipādavapuṣaḥ sattāva(ti/śi)ṣṭasya te
kāntasyāsya guṇojjhitasya bhuvane nāmāpi gṛhṇātu kaḥ //

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: devyāyatta eva devasya saṃsārikaḥ sarvo vyavahāra ity etal likhitapaṭhitam eva lokānām /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: ayi devi,

lg.l: tāvat saṃsṛtivibhramo mama bhaved yāvat tvayā saṃgamo
viśleṣo yadi magnam eva bhuvanaṃ manye kim anyat tadā /
kiṃ paśyāmi kimu spṛśāmi kim ahaṃ jalpāmi jighrāmi kiṃ
kiṃ vā nāma śṛṇomi kiṃ punar ahaṃ jānāmi yatkevalaḥ //

p.seg: mai rūḍhamūlo mamadāhimāṇo ajjauttaṃ evvaṃ vāhārei /
mayi rūḍhamūlo mamatābhimāna āryaputram evaṃ vyāhārayati /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: devi, ahaṃtābhimāna iti vaktavyam /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: īdṛśam abhinnaṃ dāmpatyam ardhanārīrūpasya mahato devasya devasya vā /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: ramaṇīyacaraṇa, kutaḥ praśāntavega iva ratho dṛśyate?

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: avasito viṣamo jāgaritanāmā vanoddeśaḥ, pratyāsannaś ca svapnārāmaḥ / tataś ca,

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: kathaṃ saṃnihitaḥ svapnārāmaḥ? parito dṛṣṭiṃ prasārya
aye ramaṇīyacaraṇa, ihasthena tvayā paripālyatām eṣa rathaḥ / yāvad aham amum ārāmaṃ praviśya sattvaśuddhidvitīyayā devyā saha viharāmi /

sp.speaker: ramaṇīyacaraṇaḥ
sp.p: tathā / iti sthitaḥ

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: devyā sattvaśuddhyā ca saha nāḍīdvārā svapnārāmapraveśaṃ nāṭayitvā / devi, atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotir atrabhavatyāḥ sāhāyakam apekṣate /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: samantād avalokya aho asya svapnārāmasya rāmaṇīyakam / devi, dṛśyatām ābhirūpyam ārāmasya / iha hi,
api ca,
hanta hanta dṛṣṭanaṣṭasvarūpāṇi pūrvadṛṣṭasarūpāṇi pratikṣaṇonnidravyaktyākṛtijātyanyathātvabhāñjyatratyāni vastūni / tathā hi,

lg.l: hastīty ākalitaḥ kṣaṇena sa mahān adriḥ samāpadyate
sadyaḥ sa drumatām upaiti sa punaḥ pakṣiprathāṃ gāhate /
vastu prāptimad apy apūrvam iva saṃprāptavyam āste punaḥ //

sp.p: devi, dīyatām ito dṛṣṭiḥ /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: devi, ārāmasīmāyām avadhāraya śrutim /

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: sattvaśuddhe, devī nidrālaseva lakṣyate / dhārayasva tāvad enām /

lg.l: mama sarve 'pi paśyanti na māṃ paśyati kaścana //

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: śrutvā atigabhīramanoharaṃ vacanam /

lg.l: upary upari saṃcarann api na kaścid akṣetravid-
na vindati tathaiva mām ahar ahar bhajann apy aho
vimohapihito janas tad iha kasya kiṃ vā bruve //

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: śrutvā asaṃśayaṃ niratiśayarūpalāvaṇyasaundaryaparyavasānabhūmitayā svasyānurūparamaṇānupalambhasaṃbhūtam ārāmābhimāninyā nigūḍhāyāḥ kasyāś cit kanyakāyā vacanam etad iti me niścayaḥ / hanta, hanta,
vatse sattvaśuddhe,

lg.l: eṣo 'haṃ ca tathā tathā vyavaharan prāpto 'smi nāma śramaṃ
vyomāgre parimaṇḍalāni vicaran nātho yathā pakṣiṇām //

sp.p: tad atisaṃnihite 'sminn atimuktātmamaṇḍape nidrālasāṃ devīṃ sukhaśāyinīṃ vidhehi / aham apy ārāmavirāmabhuvam abhigamya nirdhāritaśabdapravṛttimūlas tad evātimuktātmamaṇḍapam anupravekṣyāmi //

sp.speaker: jīvaḥ
sp.p: parikramyāvalokya ca, saharṣāścaryasaṃbhramautsukyam hanta, saphalam adya saṃjātaṃ janma /
hanta, na paryāpnuvanti sahasram api locanāni sahasralocanasya saundaryam asyā nirvarṇayituṃ, varṇayituṃ vā vāco 'pi vācaspateḥ / tathā hy asyāḥ,

lg.l: aṃśo merur asaṃśayaṃ mṛgadṛśo vakṣojayor uccayos

sp.p: api ca,

lg.l: pādau padmabhuvaḥ śriyaḥ sahacarau pāṇī śivavyañjanau
aṅgaṃ sarvam anaṅgamaṅgalam aho varṇyeta kiṃ kena vā //

sp.p: kiṃ bahunā,

lg.l: atha svarasam ātmanā yadi kadācid āliṅganaṃ
taraṅgayati jīvato mama sa eva mokṣotsavaḥ //

sp.p: kā punar eṣā bhavet / atha vā bhavatu yā kācid eṣā / paścād aśeṣaṃ vicārayiṣyāmi / sarvathā tāvad enayā saṃpraty eṣa saṃpadye / iti parikramya, niṣkrāntāḥ sarve
